title: Santa hats, blue lights: the funk Christmas trio dance
summary: You, or you and two friends in a row, wear Santa hats in a room lit blue and hit a sharp arm-cross, chest-tap routine to a fast funk Christmas beat.
why: Remake the Trend added this trend on November 21, 2026 and counted 26 creators posting an AI version in the 7 days to November 21. It traces it to a TikTok clip from November 9 that had about 4.1M views when it checked on November 21, set to a Brazilian funk remix of a classic Christmas song. Our other holiday dances are bouncy duos by the tree; this one is a sharp, cool-faced routine in blue light.
steps: Pick a clear, full-length or knee-up photo of yourself, or of you and up to two friends who agreed to be in it.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool with the photo.
Add a fast funk Christmas sound from the app's library, and trim the clip to match the beat.
Post it and say it's made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: you and two friends
prompts.text: Use the people in this photo. Keep their faces, hair, skin tones and body shapes exactly the same, and dress each of them in a red Santa hat with their own casual clothes. They stand side by side in a row in a living room at night. Blue LED strip lights glow along the ceiling, a small Christmas tree with warm fairy lights sits behind them. Fixed camera at chest height, about three metres away, showing them from head to knees. One continuous 10-second vertical shot, no cuts, no zoom. Seconds 0 to 2: they stand still, then all snap their arms across their chests in an X with hands on their shoulders. Seconds 2 to 4: quick alternating flat-hand chest taps with bouncing knees. Seconds 4 to 6: one hand up to the mouth, then both arms swing wide and back across the chest. Seconds 6 to 8: they repeat the arm cross and chest taps a little bigger, nodding to the beat. Seconds 8 to 10: they finish with arms crossed and chins up, holding a cool pose at the camera. Moves in perfect sync. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: just you
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Keep their face, hair and body exactly the same, and add a red Santa hat. They stand alone in the middle of a dark bedroom lit by blue LED lights and a string of warm fairy lights on the wall. Fixed camera at chest height, head to knees, one continuous 10-second vertical shot. They snap their arms into an X across the chest, do quick chest taps with bouncing knees, raise one hand to the mouth, swing both arms wide, repeat the cross a little bigger, then end with arms crossed and a confident smirk at the camera. Sharp, on-beat movement. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: the team at the counter
prompts.text: Use the people in this photo of my team [upload]. Keep every face and body the same and give each person a red Santa hat over their work clothes. They stand in a row behind our shop counter after closing, lit by blue strip lights and warm fairy lights along the shelves. Fixed camera at chest height, one continuous 10-second vertical shot. They do the same routine in sync: arms snap into an X across the chest, quick chest taps with bouncing knees, one hand to the mouth, arms swing wide, the cross again, then a final pose with arms crossed and chins up. No text, no logos or brand names.

tips: Three people in a row reads best. Leave space between them in your photo so the arms don't merge.
If the moves drift out of sync, shorten the prompt to the X cross, chest taps and final pose.
Blue light can wash out faces. Ask for "warm light on the faces" if they look grey.
Only use photos of people who are happy to be in it, and say it's made with AI.
